result.title: Multistage Contextual Optimization for Vehicle Repositioning
result.summary: Ride-hailing platforms reposition idle vehicles to improve spatial supply-demand balances. This problem is prediction-driven and multistage: at each stage, the platform forecasts future demand, executes current decisions, and uses the resulting state to initialize the next stage. We formulate a multistage linear program (LP) with a macroscopic fundamental diagram (MFD) linking accumulation to trip completion. We then develop a multistage contextual optimization approach that uses decision performance to train the prediction model. The learning problem combines multiple coupled stages, context that depends on earlier decisions, and predictions that affect the objective, the constraint matrix, and the right-hand side of the LP. We derive the exact gradient, which has three parts: parameters change forecasts and hence decisions; earlier decisions change the current decision through the inherited state; and this state also changes forecasts as context. An equivalent adjoint uses reverse vector-Jacobian products, avoiding full solution and state-parameter Jacobians. Finally, forward propagation solves many stage LPs one after another, which makes training slow. We propose a parallel block evaluation algorithm that solves blocks of consecutive stages in parallel and repeatedly feeds each block output to the next block. We prove that the algorithm recovers the serial trajectory within a finite number of passes and that its gradient error remains bounded when it stops early. On New York City ride-hailing data, multistage contextual optimization yields 7.7% to 9.1% more business benefit than the same predictor trained by mean squared error, outperforms all compared baselines from five paradigms, and even outperforms realized demand fed to the same policy. With eight workers, parallel block evaluation shortens training by a factor of 1.86 without loss of decision performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究网约车闲置车辆再定位的多阶段线性规划问题，提出以决策表现而非预测误差训练预测模型的多阶段上下文优化方法，给出含状态继承项的精确梯度与伴随反向计算，并提出并行分块求解与有限轮内恢复串行轨迹、提前停止时梯度误差有界的分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按决策效果训练预测器、梯度中显式分解「前序决策经继承状态影响当前决策」的贡献分配，以及分块并行迭代并分析提前停止误差的做法，可能为 latent 多步推理的轨迹监督与并行/停止机制提供可供核查的线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
